seed_fields.description: Run the complete padded attack with an explicitly supplied row normalizer. The source recipe chooses mean-absolute or population-standard-deviation scaling at each recurrent update. The graph supplies the numerical function. Preserve all source model branches, label rules, momentum updates, projection, and real-entry PNG encoding. No implicit pretrained state is downloaded.

providers.operation: Run the full source attack using the row scaling function supplied by the graph.
providers.plain_limits: Use checked image inputs, explicit model settings, and the reviewed scaling function. Keep all model branches, repeated updates, padding, and output rules. Only real images are returned. The bound on normalized values does not guarantee a bound on saved image pixels. No trained weights are downloaded.
providers.validity_bounds: Prepared version-1 decoded dictionary from adversarial_prepare, with exact rgb, targets, config and initializations fields, plus an explicit callable accepting values and statistic. The callable must implement the qualified uncentered mean-absolute/population-std row scaling, preserving finite float32 rows; callable identity is a graph binding obligation. Full CPU Torch source-shaped ensembles: non-targeted eight models and caller-positive iteration count (default 10); targeted epsilon>=8 five models/20 steps; targeted epsilon<8 two models/40 steps. Frozen inferred or supplied labels; main/auxiliary objectives, source momentum, round/sign policy, step clipping and fixed-original projection preserved. Source ten-entry padding and real-entry trimming/PNG min-max stretching retained. Zero/nonfinite normalization rejects. Explicit random or caller-decoded Slim states only; exact state shapes validated by model construction. No historical TensorFlow binary or pretrained quality guarantee.

parameters.prepared: Decoded dictionary from the unchanged version-1 preparation provider. Image layout is nonempty uint8 NHWC 299x299x3 before source padding/normalization; source mode, finite epsilon in [0,255], nonnegative momentum, targets and exact branch initialization scopes must satisfy its contract.
parameters.normalizer: Explicit callable accepting (values: ndarray, statistic: str) and returning same-shape/dtype finite rows under the qualified uncentered scaling contract. No hidden fallback. The approved graph must bind the qualified generic provider.

providers.outputs: Version-1 JSON-compatible dictionary: encoded normalized real images, encoded labels, base64 real-entry PNGs, per-batch losses, initialization kinds, and saved_pixel_bound_guaranteed=False.
providers.reuse: Source recipe adapter with an explicit callable port. Generic row scaling is independently selectable and contains no source recipe policy.

callable_dependency_contracts.normalizer: Graph must bind the reviewed row-scaling provider; this is a callable input, not a hardcoded internal atom import.

seed_fields.description: Divide each row by its mean absolute value or population standard deviation. Accept nonempty finite 2D float32/float64 arrays. Statistic must be exactly 'mean_absolute' or 'population_std'. Keep NumPy input-dtype reductions and output dtype. Population standard deviation uses ddof=0; the numerator is NOT centered. Reject zero or nonfinite scales and nonfinite results, without an epsilon stabilizer. Return a fresh array; input is unchanged. Meaning of each row and column, units and downstream use are entirely caller policy.

providers.operation: Divide each row by its average absolute size or by its population standard deviation.
providers.plain_limits: Use a nonempty table of finite numbers stored in 32 or 64 bit form. Choose the scale explicitly. Do not subtract the row average. The result keeps the shape and number format. The input is unchanged. Zero scales and nonfinite results are rejected.
providers.validity_bounds: Nonempty finite 2D NumPy float32/float64 ndarray. Statistic is exactly mean_absolute or population_std. Divide each row by its mean absolute value or population standard deviation (ddof=0), reduced in the input dtype. The numerator is never centered. Preserve dtype and shape; return a fresh array. Reject zero/nonfinite divisors, nonfinite inputs and nonfinite outputs without any stabilizing epsilon. Axis meaning, units, sample interpretation and downstream domain are caller policy.

parameters.values: Nonempty finite two-dimensional float32/float64 ndarray; no implicit conversion from lists or integer arrays.
parameters.statistic: Exact string mean_absolute or population_std; selects the per-row divisor, not numerator centering.

providers.outputs: Fresh finite array of the same shape and dtype; caller values are unchanged.
providers.reuse: Domain independent: rows and columns have no image, model, competition or task meaning in this operation.
